Name: Soda Crop
Author: Luminte
Description:
[left]﻿[size=3]Soda Crop is a soda focused mod that also adds some crops and a new tree. It currently has 2 crops and 1 tree, but will be updated whenever I have an idea for new soda and related crops/trees.

Crops and Trees include(seeds can be purchased at pierres):[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Burdock - spring and summer[/size]
[*][size=3]Sarsaparilla - summer[/size]
[*][size=3]Sassafras Tree - any season[/size]
[/list][size=3]
A Carbonator can turn 2 of any Crop and most forage into soda with one sugar, with some exceptions which will be sent via mail.
(after [size=3]Spring 15th Year 1,[/size] a free Carbonator will be sent via mail and the recipe can be purchased from Robin)

Carbonator Recipes:
[spoiler]
Cream Soda: two jugs of Milk and one Sugar
Dandelion & Burdock: one Dandelion, one Burdock Root, and one Sugar
Prismatica: one Prismatic Shard and one Sugar
Root Beer: two Sassafras Roots and one Sugar
Sarsaparilla: two Sarsaparilla Vines and one Sugar
Sparkling Espresso: two Coffee and one Sugar
StarPop: one Starfruit, one Crystal Fruit, and one Sugar[/size][size=3]
[/spoiler]

[/size][size=3]Some shops also have new drinks:[/size][size=3]
[spoiler]
Dr. Joja - JojaMart
Joja Bluu - JojaMart(after seeing Shane's second 7 heart event)
Pilsner - Saloon
Fisherman's Fizz - Willy's shop
[/spoiler]

Installation:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs (EMC)[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Install Soda Crop, unzip it and drop it in the mods folder[/size]
[/list]

 [/left][center]﻿[/center]
